gold_sql:
WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.geometry
  FROM pois p
  WHERE ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.221948 35.663044)',4326)::geography, 4800)
    AND p.leisure = 'stadium'
),
poi_elev AS (
  SELECT c.id, elev.z
  FROM candidates c
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, c.geometry::geometry) AS z
    FROM public.dem_us d
    WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, c.geometry::geometry)
    LIMIT 1
  ) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM poi_elev
WHERE z <= 460;

buffered_area AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(stadium_point.geom, 4800) AS geom
  FROM stadium_point
),
dem_clip AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(rast, TRUE, buffered_area.geom) AS clipped_rast
  FROM public.dem_us, buffered_area
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, buffered_area.geom)
),
elevation_filter AS (
  SELECT (ST_DumpAsPolygons(clipped_rast, 1)).* 
  FROM dem_clip
),
filtered_by_elevation AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM elevation_filter
  WHERE val <= 460
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_stadia
FROM filtered_by_elevation, museum_point
WHERE ST_DWithin(filtered_by_elevation.geom, museum_point.geom, 4800);
